scientific_target: Within-one-physical-station and original matched-date-pair detected EVENT encounter/active-passage early-versus-late seasonal odds ratio; not automatically circadian physiology, active state or zeitgeber causality
observation_model: Independent Poisson means mu_bk = known externally logged operating_hours_bk * latent_encounter_rate_bk * detector_sensitivity_bk, conditional on both season and bin margins; four observed event cells
fisher_conditioning: Condition exact season totals, phase-bin totals; X=falling_early is Fisher noncentral hypergeometric parameter theta_count. One-sided H0: theta_encounter<=1 with calibrated theta_detector<=B tests upper tail at theta_count=theta_effort*B.
calibration_bounds: B_gamma_upper=(q_falling_early_upper * q_rising_late_upper)/(q_rising_early_lower*q_falling_late_lower); lower analogous; all four bounds must come from simultaneous independent calibration coverage, NOT unadjusted marginal intervals
exact_nchypergeom: weights_x=choose(K,x)choose(N-K,D-x)*theta_count**x, finite support max(0,K+D-N)..min(K,D). Use lgamma logsumexp.
lower_95pct_limit: Invert right-tail p_theta(X>=Xobs)=0.05 in theta_count, then divide by known effort OR and maximal detector OR. A result >1 supports positive encounter OR under explicitly certified detector calibration; uncalibrated q leaves no nontrivial lower bound.
acceptance_gates: all five source-free 2x2 scenarios and five B grid values, every result retained
all two independent hypothetical calibration shapes across all scenarios
one-sided exact hypergeom upper-tail inversion checked against direct p value
when B increases, robust p does not decrease, lower latent confidence bound does not increase
if theta_count/effort<=1, no positive season rate inferred with B>=1
unequal_effort_only observed raw OR=2 but effort-adjusted point OR=1
uncalibrated detector seasonal crossproduct unrestricted, so no finite lower bound or causal conclusion
all sensitivity priors/hardware q calibrations are arbitrary simulated examples and never EcoBank values
no selection of sites/day-pairs or bins based on outcomes; 2 preselected bins only
all source independent camera operation and detector calibration provenance real world remains HOLD
no real ungulate events, protected coordinates or original source rows accessed
no qualified ODSP inferential result or previous route reclassification
interpretation: Point and exact one-sided statistical lower bound for a within-site early/late seasonal encounter-rate odds ratio under bounded detector efficiency; not direct biological activity or photoperiod memory inference.
